# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

print(f"Total severe patients: {severe_df.shape[0]}")
print(f"Severe patients with sentinel values in baseline biomarker: {severe_df[severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0].shape[0]}")

# Calculate mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients, excluding sentinel values
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_df[severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
